statements.markdown: **Lemma 4.3 (inner low-degree test; cf. [ABSSW26, Lemma 4.3]).** On a table $w:F^{cb}\times\mathcal B_r\to\mathbb F_2$, the inner low-degree test flips a fair coin between the Hadamard test on $w(\xi,\cdot)$ at a uniform inner point $\xi$ and a one-bit observation of the standard low-degree test, (10) read through a uniform homogeneous label at uniform $u,v$. If $q>2c$ and the test rejects with probability $\kappa$, some polynomial $U$ of total degree at most $c$ satisfies
statements.section: 4. Low-degree tests over the binary alphabet
